create_ConvNextConfig_default: create a ConvNextConfig with default settings for convnext-tiny-224 style model
create_ConvNextConfig_custom: create a ConvNextConfig with custom hidden_sizes, depths, patch_size, and image_size parameters
create_ConvNextConfig_backbone: create a ConvNextConfig with out_indices and out_features for backbone feature extraction
